format: Standard Territory Chem-Dry franchise (approximately 100,000 to 150,000 households, one van, may be home-based for 24 months)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Chem-Dry Franchised Business is $117,645 to $240,995 for a Standard Territory, and $99,645 to $222,995 for a Small Territory. This includes $105,495 - $111,495 for a Standard Territory

fee.quote: Upon signing the Franchise Agreement, you must pay an initial franchise fee of $36,000 for a Standard Territory and $18,000 for a Small Territory (the "Initial Franchise Fee").
fee.note: Item 7 high of $42,000 reflects additional territory at $0.20 per household up to 180,000 households. Small Territory (approximately 75,000 households): $18,000 to $24,000. Also required: Initial Package Fee of $69,495 (equipment, supplies, inventory). Veterans 20% off; first responders 10% off; Related Franchisee 25% off; $5,400 off each additional Standard Territory bought at the same time; negotiable discounts for existing carpet cleaning businesses.

royalty.basis: monthly Gross Sales, tiered by annual Gross Sales (Standard Territory: 7% on $0-$500,000, 6% on $500,001-$1,000,000, 5% on $1,000,001-$1,500,000, 4% above $1,500,000), subject to a minimum monthly royalty
royalty.quote: Royalty Between 4% and 7% of Gross Sales, beginning the first month after Initial Training ... Beginning in your 13th month of operation of the Franchise. Royalty payments are subject to a required minimum monthly Royalty payment

adFund.quote: Brand Marketing Fee Up to 3% of Gross Sales, beginning in month 13 of franchise operation. Brand Marketing Fee payments are subject to a minimum monthly payment of no less than $150 for the Standard Territory and $75 for the Small Territory
adFund.note: Up to 3% of Gross Sales from month 13, minimum $150 per month (Standard Territory); the FDD does not state the current rate below the 3% cap.

otherRecurring.name: Technology Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Presently, the Technology Fee is $450 per month

otherRecurring.name: Ongoing Purchases (products from franchisor as sole supplier)
otherRecurring.amount: Product Costs, generally between $5,000 and $50,000 annually

otherRecurring.name: Convention
otherRecurring.amount: $1,000 maximum per person to attend the Convention; Convention Non-Attendance Fee presently $1,000

otherRecurring.name: NORA Fee (optional national accounts)
otherRecurring.amount: presently this fee is up to 15% of Gross Sales generated by the NORA Account

transferFee.amount: Currently, $3,600 (may increase up to 10% each year of the term); plus a broker fee of approximately $30,000 if a third-party broker located the transferee

headline.label: Projected annual Gross Revenue (a projection, not actual results), Standard Territory, one van operating 52 weeks

item19.quote: Standard Territory 125,000 Households Jobs Per Day 3 Days Per Week 4 Projected Average Income Per Job $350 Projected Weekly Revenue $4,200 Projected Annual Revenue $218,400
item19.note: This is a projection, not historical sales: 'The following below information is projection of annual Gross Revenue, assuming a franchisee operates in a Standard Territory, operating one (1) van for fifty-two (52) weeks.' Based on existing franchisees averaging over 20 years in operation, in non-exclusive territories. No costs or profit.

special: Royalty is tiered (7% down to 4%) with a minimum monthly royalty rising from $900 to $3,100 (Standard Territory) and minimum monthly Gross Sales requirements ($16,700 rising to $83,300). Franchisor is sole supplier of core cleaning products (ongoing purchases generally $5,000 to $50,000 annually) and the $69,495 Initial Package. Liquidated damages on early termination: greater of 36 months of royalties paid or 36 months of Minimum Royalty. The system shrank from 1,692 to 1,099 franchised outlets over 2022-2024.
issues: FDD is the 2025 edition (issued 2025-03-28, amended 2025-06-30); outlet data is for 2024. Item 19 is a projection, not actual average sales. Item 6 royalty row is ambiguous on whether royalty starts after Initial Training or in month 13 (the minimum royalty starts month 13). Current Brand Marketing Fee rate not stated (only 'up to 3%'). Technology Fee annual amount computed as $450 x 12.

source.registrant: Chem-Dry, Inc., f/k/a Harris Research, Inc.
